confirmDiff.title: Confirm with a diff before saving
confirmDiff.desc: Review changes against the on-disk file before writing.

launchOnStartup.title: Launch on startup
launchOnStartup.desc: Start Abyss when you log in (applied on next launch).

autosave.title: Autosave
autosave.desc: Automatically save the open config file after the configured idle period.

autosaveDelay.title: Autosave delay
autosaveDelay.desc: Idle time (in seconds) before the file is saved automatically (1–30).

editorLineWrap.title: Editor line wrap
editorLineWrap.desc: Wrap long lines in the config editor instead of scrolling horizontally.

guidedTour.title: Guided tour
guidedTour.desc: Replay the short walkthrough of the main areas of Abyss.

startupAgent.title: Agent on startup
startupAgent.desc: Which agent Abyss opens with. “Last used” restores your most recent agent.

language.title: Language
language.desc: Interface language. Applies instantly — no restart needed.

billingMode.title: Billing mode
billingMode.desc: Subscription has no per-token cost; API is pay-as-you-go.

showCosts.title: Show estimated costs
showCosts.desc: Display an approximate token cost on the dashboard.

currency.title: Currency
currency.desc: Currency used for the cost estimate.

weeklyBudget.title: Weekly token budget
weeklyBudget.desc: Your plan's weekly allowance — drives the % quota gauge on the dashboard.

sessionBudget.title: Session (5h) token budget
sessionBudget.desc: Rolling 5-hour allowance, shown as a percentage consumed.

budgetAlert.title: Budget alert threshold
budgetAlert.desc: Warn on the usage gauge once consumption reaches this percentage (0 = off).
